messages:
maria_cs: Galileo renewal needs exec sign by Fri. Procurement says they require a vendor 'stamp' + escrow addendum — do we have a standard addendum we can send?
jason_aes: putting on @alex_salesops. We also committed a 10% demo credit last quarter — can that offset first invoice? Finance prefers wire vs CC for this account.
alex_salesops: We do have "Vendor Escrow Addendum v2" in the contracts lib. Snippet below:
```
Escrow clause: Funds will be held in escrow with [CustBank] pending delivery milestones; vendor stamp required on page 3.
```
alex_salesops: I'll upload the PDF and tag procurement.
legal_bot: Legal: addendum needs PO, TaxID, and authorized signatory on page 2. If escrow is requested, we must route for ops review and updated indemnities.
ops_ian: I can handle escrow routing. Need client bank details + expected close date. Also confirm whether escrow will be onshore/offshore.
billing_amy: Billing flag: demo credit can be applied to first invoice only after signed SOW. For wire we need invoice to the billed entity — confirm 'Galileo Inc EU' vs 'Galileo Labs US'.
maria_cs: I'll confirm entity & signatory today and chase the CFO. @jason_aes can you nudge them for Friday? :pray:
docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope created (env_7843) — awaiting signature from "CFO, Galileo". Reminder set for 48h.
maria_cs: thanks — once CFO signs I'll drop the addendum + upload invoice to billing. keeping thread for visibility.
